name: Scrap-Rat Swarm
text: Dozens of scavenged-metal rats, fused together by rot.
onDefeat: The swarm scatters and leaves a working component behind.
onEscape: TODO(drew): escape cost is an open question (rules.md §11).
onStun: The swarm reels. It goes back into the Adventure Deck and may show up again.

name: The Static Warden
text: What's left of the mall's old security system, grown into something else.
onStun: The Warden stutters offline long enough to reach the core.

name: Corroded Sentinel
text: An old security unit, still running on a decade-old threat list.
onDefeat: TODO(drew): no defeat result authored yet.
onEscape: TODO(drew): escape cost is an open question (rules.md §11).
onStun: It goes back into the Adventure Deck and may show up again.

name: Wastewalker
text: Another scavenger, sizing you up the same way you're sizing them up. Trade, share info, or walk away. Turns hostile only if provoked.

name: Lost Courier
text: Separated from their caravan, low on supplies. Help them and they point you to a cache: draw 1 Item. No check.
